basic_info.description: This spectacular 3 bd, 2 bath contemporary gem delivers sweeping & unimaginable views from atop Ingleside Heights. The thoughtfully updated kitchen is sleek, tasteful & highly functional, equipped w/ Bosch appliances & a Bertazzoni oven. Prepare delicious meals & connect w/ family & friends while enjoying the most amazing sunsets. Relax in the tranquil living space, w/ tons of natural light which streams through the large windows - enhancing the overall easy flow & peaceful vibe. 2 bd & 1 bath sit on the top floor, while a large master suite retreat w/ a spa-like shower, awaits you downstairs. Entertain & delight in the expansive, multi-level backyard. This unique outdoor space is equipped w/ a BBQ patio, beautiful landscaping, & ocean views - making 371 Bright a true oasis. Located in highly desirable Ingleside Heights, this home is central to many conveniences & amenities including Whole Foods, Target, Philz Coffee & tons of restaurants & bars. Easy access to MUNI & freeways.
